answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can use staggered reputation summits: each agent must earn endorsement from independent, already-established peers through distinct, verifiable tasks before reaching the summit of full trading rights. Like a sparrow joining a flock only after repeated, observed flights, a new identity cannot buy instant trust. Each fake identity then needs separate work, separate endorsers, and separate history, so the cost ripples outward with every clone, while honest agents reuse one established reputation.
